Rehabilitation therapists use a number of evidence-based 
measures of upper and lower extremity physical function and 
performance that include muscle resistance testing, walking 
tests, stair climbing, rising from a chair, and balance. A score 
is determined for each test and summed for interpretation 
(Ha, 2010). Working collaboratively with rehabilitation thera-
